maddeler.e: اِسْتَجَارَ مِنَ الرَّمْضَاءَ بِالنَّارِ • (istajāra mina r-ramḍāʔa bi-n-nāri)
maddeler.t: Literally, “to seek protection from scorching ground by turning to fire”.
s: “to seek protection from scorching ground by turning to fire”
Literally, “to seek protection from scorching ground by turning to fire”
